observations: When a person's new comment mentions the claimant and the mention resolves to it, the claimant route is suppressed even when the mention send then fails. This happens when the listener answers 404 (the INFRA-141 cold-cache shape) and when the session does not advertise the delivery mode. In both cases the claimant gets no copy on its own topic. The plan (A3, trickyParts) accepts this, and base gives the claimant no copy in this case either, so it is no regression. Sent to the architect as a risk.

When the route is role:<r> and the claimant holds that role, the Reaches panel counts 3 recipients where 2 distinct sessions are reached, because the role row is the route text, as the plan says. This is display only and changes no delivery.
